title: In lieu of other compensation.
bodyText: Any such restoration or setting of new boundary markers shall be in lieu of all other compensation for the disturbance or removal.
bodyHtml: §264-5  In lieu of other compensation.  Any such restoration or setting of new boundary markers shall be in lieu of all other compensation for the disturbance or removal. [L 1953, c 62, §2; RL 1955, §111-41; HRS §264-5]
